# Draft:Battle of Bangongluo

Battle of Bangongluo is, in Chinese narrative, the combination of two concurrent battles during the second phase of 1962 Sino-Indian War which both took place on November 18, 1962 and in the western part Sino-Indian LAC, the two battles were:
*Battle of Rezang La, which is known by the Chinese as Battle of No.8 & 9 Indian Posts of Ngari
*Battle of Gurung Hill, which is known by the Chinese as Battle of No.16 Indian Post of Ngari
